fieldNotes.truckGate: The access drive connects to Digital Drive as an open, uncontrolled driveway. Street View (2025-02) of the Digital Drive frontage shows no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point - just a landscaped open entrance. The perimeter access road wrapping the building is likewise ungated.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the entrance or anywhere on the perimeter drive in satellite or Street View imagery.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal access drive from Digital Drive plus a full-length perimeter road to the west drop yard - ample queue room.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Full-length west drop yard with trailers parked nose-out plus dock-staged trailers; 50+ stalls.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long bank of dock doors along the west building face with many trailers backed in; ~50 estimated, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open Digital Drive entrance and a broad perimeter road with no control structure - room for a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Niagara built on a 48-acre parcel; developed footprint measures ~35 acres.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in Meadowville Technology Park, Chesterfield County, within the Richmond VA metro - surrounded by large distribution buildings. Urban.
